subject.title: fix(mcp): suppress unhandled rejection from async gateway event handler

question: Should MCP gateway event-handler rejection containment land through this focused PR, through the broader open maintainer batch, or move into a shared GatewayClient callback policy first?
rationale: The patch is correct, but the merge choice includes event-delivery semantics and an overlapping maintainer batch, which automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Land the focused MCP PR
options.body: Merge this narrow PR after normal maintainer approval if log-and-continue without retry is the desired containment behavior.

options.title: Let the batch supersede it
options.body: Keep this PR open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100258 merges, then close this PR as superseded with contributor credit preserved.

options.title: Define shared callback policy first
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want async onEvent rejection containment enforced in GatewayClient for all consumers rather than only in the MCP bridge.

recommendation.title: Land the focused MCP PR
recommendation.body: Merge this narrow PR after normal maintainer approval if log-and-continue without retry is the desired containment behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned on this PR and authored the overlapping maintainer batch carrying the same MCP fix.
